# Special Education Due Process Complaint Writer

> A free AI plugin and skill for Claude (Chat, Cowork and Claude Code) and ChatGPT (the desktop app and Codex) that writes an IDEA special education due process complaint from a child's IEP, school documents and other important information, for any US state and the District of Columbia. It asks who is filing; reads the IEPs, evaluations, prior written notices, progress reports, service logs and emails; confirms the facts with the person filing and resolves what disagrees; confirms the state's filing details on its official filing page and looks up the school district's office and address on the district's own website; recommends every claim the record supports and lets the person choose the claims and relief; researches the law for the filing state and the federal circuit it sits in; drafts the complaint as a pleading, each claim answering the reason the district gave in its own documents; checks that every date, figure and quotation is in the documents or the person's own words, that every count is recomputed from sourced inputs, and that every element 34 C.F.R. § 300.508(b) requires is there; flags anything it could not verify, including any citation whose text it did not read; audits the draft against fourteen checks; and delivers it as a PDF to file and a Word file to edit, with review notes after a page break to remove before filing. It is for special education attorneys, legal aid organizations, advocates and parents. It is not legal advice and says nothing about how a complaint will fare.

Install in the Claude app (Chat selected, not Code): Customize → Plugins → Add → Add marketplace → Add from a repository → paste https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint → Sync → Add next to Due Process Complaint Writer. Requires a paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise). Install in the ChatGPT desktop app: Settings → Plugins → Add → Add a marketplace → paste https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint → Add marketplace, then Plugins → Personal → Try now. In Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint`. In Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint`, then `/plugin install due-process-complaint@due-process-complaint`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/README.md): what it produces, how it keeps facts honest, installation, frequently asked questions
- [The skill's procedure](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/skills/due-process-complaint/SKILL.md): the steps the AI follows, from reading the documents to handing over the complaint
- [The form of the complaint](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/skills/due-process-complaint/references/exemplar.md): caption, introduction, contact and residence information, statement of facts, statement of the problems, proposed resolution, signature, certificate of service
- [The claims and what each turns on](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/skills/due-process-complaint/references/claims.md): the eighteen claims, the parts each requires with its regulation, and what counts as a fact for a part
- [What may be cited, and on whose word](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/skills/due-process-complaint/references/authorities.md): the three tiers, the cases that bind everywhere, the Second Circuit block, how the filing state's circuit is read, and the rule that no unconfirmed citation is written
- [The audit before delivery](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/skills/due-process-complaint/references/audit.md): the fourteen checks a script cannot catch, the review notes, and the verification checklist

## Examples

- [California, filed by a parent pro se (PDF)](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/examples/river-oak/complaint.pdf): the finished complaint from a complete run on invented documents
- [North Carolina, filed by an attorney (PDF)](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/examples/pine-hollow/complaint.pdf): the finished complaint from a complete run on invented documents, with a one-year filing window

- [Where to file, by state](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/STATES.md): for all 50 states and DC, the office that receives a special education due process complaint, its official filing page, address, email, fax, time limit and a filing note

## Optional

- [51-state filing research](https://github.com/b33kman/special-education-due-process-complaint/blob/main/skills/due-process-complaint/references/state-rules.json): each state's official due process filing page (filingUrl), with the address, fax, email, portal and the federal circuit whose decisions bind it, as researched in 2026; the filing page is looked up again every run
